graders.api_surface: Claude Code print mode with stream-json output, safe mode, strict empty MCP configuration, dontAsk permissions, an explicit empty built-in tool set, and explicit denials for filesystem, shell, web, skill, and agent tools in a read-only coordinator workspace.
graders.trace_method: Capture the complete stream-json trace from system init through the terminal result; require init tools and MCP servers to be empty and no tool_use content blocks.
notes: The init record exposed no tools or MCP servers, no tool-use block occurred, the sole response was ZERO_TOOLS_QUALIFIED, and the terminal result was complete and successful.
Safe mode may list built-in slash-command metadata, but the explicit empty tool set leaves no model-callable Skill or filesystem capability.
